    # occupied start = input nonzero
    occ={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]}
    # order: closed first (they rise to ceiling), then open (fall), each group scan top-to-bottom
    closed_g=opened=[]
    for o in comps:
        closed_o,open_o=[],[]
        h=max(r for r,_ in o['rel'])+1; w_=max(c for _,c in o['rel'])+1
        r0=o['r0']; c0=o['c0']
        enc=False
        for ii in range(h):
            for jj in range(w_):
                if g[r0+ii][c0+jj]==0 and not e[r0+ii][c0+jj]: enc=True
        (closed_g if enc else open_o).append(o)
    groups=[sorted(closed_g,key=lambda o:o['r0']),sorted(open_o,key=lambda o:o['r0'])]
    def slide(o,dr,occ):
        step=dr
        while True:
            nr=o['r0']+step
            nrel=[(nr+p,o['c0']+cc) for p,cc in o['rel']]
            ok=all(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W for x,y in nrel) and all(ni not in occ or ni==False for ni in [(x,y) for x,y in nrel if not any((o['r0']+p,x)==ni for p,x in o['rel'])])
            # blocked if any target cell out of bounds or occupied by another object
            if not ok: return o['r0']
            o['r0']=nr
            occ|=set(nrel)
        return o['r0']
    for grp in groups:

            o['r0']=slide(o,-1 if enc_for(o) else 1,{})

    # clean implementation below
    settled=set()
    order=closed_g+open_o
    for o in order:
        dr=1 if not is_closed(o,g) else -1
        while True:
            nr=o['r0']+dr
            nrel=[(nr+p,o['c0']+cc) for p,cc in o['rel']]

from collections import deque
def f4(g, mode='enclosed_first'):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=classify3(g)
    def bbox(o):
        rmin=min(p for p,_ in o['rel']); cmin=min(q for _,q in o['rel'])
        rmax=max(p for p,_ in o['rel']); cmax=max(q for _,q in o['rel'])
        return ((rmin,cmin),(rmax,cmax))
    # initial occupancy
    occ={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]}
    pos=[(o['r0'],o['c0']) for o in objs]
    # order: enclosed first, sorted by distance to top edge; then open sorted by distance to bottom
    enc_sorted=sorted([o for o in objs if o['enclosed']], key=lambda o:o['r0'])
    open_sorted=sorted([o for o in objs if not o['enclosed']], key=lambda o:- (H-max(rmin(c,o)) ))  # placeholder
    order=[]
    for o in enc_sorted: order.append(('u',o))
    for o in open_sorted: order.append(('d',o))
    cur_pos=pos[:]
    moved=True
    while moved:
        moved=False
        for typ,o in order:
            r0,c0=cur_pos[objs.index(o)]
            dr=-1 if typ=='u' else 1
            nr=r0+dr
            nabs={(nr+p,c0+cc) for p,cc in o['rel']}
            ok=all(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W for x,y in nabs) and not(nabs & occ)
            if ok:
                cur_pos[objs.index(o)]=(nr,c0)
                moved=True
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for k,o in enumerate(objs):
        r0,c0=cur_pos[k]
        for p,cc in o['rel']: out[r0+p][c0+cc]=o['v']
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comp(g)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for (r0,c0,v,rel,enc) in cs:
        nr = 0 if enc else H-1-max(p for p,_ in rel)
        for p,q in rel: out[nr+p][c0+q]=v
    return out
for d in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(d, f(G[d+' input'])==G[d+' output'])
